issues: Minor: residual pre-existing TEST Siswa (64e24030/1b7adcf0/b632e697) rows persist in global leaderboard from earlier dev/test runs — not from this iteration. Consider a one-off cleanup or ensure cleanup fixtures in dev.

critical_code_review_comments: points_leaderboard aggregation ($group with {_id:'$user_id', name:$last:$user_name, kelas:$last:$kelas}) — using $last on unsorted group may yield stale user_name/kelas if a student changes class. Not blocking but consider $first with pre-sort by created_at desc or re-join to users collection.

ppdb_register still accepts jurusan_pilihan as Optional in payload — good backward compatibility; frontend no longer sends it. Consider removing the field from PpdbIn in a later cleanup once no clients send it.
backend/server.py is now ~4852 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Already flagged previously; splitting into routers (auth/users/ppdb/attendance/points/schoolgram) would greatly aid maintainability.
/api/attendance/scan returns the full student doc via strip() — strip() removes password_hash and _id, good; but is_demo and parent_* fields are still returned. Non-critical.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway guru + 3 throwaway siswa created per run, PPDB entry created+deleted. All created users deleted via DELETE /api/users/{id} at end of each playwright run and pytest teardown. Super admin never touched.
